name: ModelVariant769_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant769_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (particles gather into a textured orb on one slot, the orb is launched across the field with flapping wings and bursts, and a ring grows with a falling spray at the other slot); for a non-negative request it selects the command record indexed by the request, seeds the gathering particles, ring points and spray and packs two texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 4 while the orb waits at the far side, 1 once when it bursts, 2 once the fade has finished and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-786 and 883 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
